description: This file defines the declaration of the AmbiorixClient class, which manages connection and data interactions with the Ambiorix backend, including methods for connection, data retrieval, object manipulation, and event handling within the beerocks namespace.

classes.name: AmbiorixClient
classes.description: A class managing the connection and operations with the Ambiorix backend, including connection setup, data retrieval, object management, and event loop integration.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Connects to an Ambiorix backend using specified backend path and bus URI.

methods.name: get_object
methods.description: Retrieves the content tree of the first object matching the given path up to a specified depth.

methods.name: bool get_param(T & result,const std::string & obj_path,const std::string & param_name)
methods.description: Retrieves a parameter value from a specified object path.

methods.name: T get_object_multi(const std::string & object_path,const int32_t depth=0)
methods.description: Retrieves multiple objects matching a path, returning contents in a specified smart pointer type.

methods.name: resolve_path
methods.description: Resolves a search path to an absolute path if possible.

methods.name: resolve_path_multi
methods.description: Resolves a search path to all matching absolute paths.

methods.name: update_object
methods.description: Updates the content of a specified object.

methods.name: add_instance
methods.description: Adds a new instance under a specified object path.

methods.name: remove_instance
methods.description: Removes an instance identified by its ID under a specified object path.

methods.name: call
methods.description: Invokes a method on a specified object with arguments and retrieves the result.

methods.name: get_fd
methods.description: Returns the file descriptor for the Ambiorix connection.

methods.name: get_signal_fd
methods.description: Returns the signal file descriptor for the Ambiorix connection.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Reads data from the connection's file descriptor, typically called when data is available.

methods.name: read_signal
methods.description: Reads data from the signal file descriptor.

methods.name: init_event_loop
methods.description: Initializes event handlers for the connection's file descriptor within an event loop.

methods.name: init_signal_loop
methods.description: Initializes event handlers for the signal file descriptor within an event loop.

methods.name: remove_event_loop
methods.description: Removes event handlers for the connection's file descriptor from an event loop.

methods.name: remove_signal_loop
methods.description: Removes event handlers for the signal file descriptor from an event loop.

methods.name: subscribe_to_object_event
methods.description: Subscribes to events for a specific object.

methods.name: unsubscribe_from_object_event
methods.description: Unsubscribes from events for a specific object.

methods.name: AmbiorixClient()
methods.description: unavailable

ctags.pattern: /^    T get_object_multi(const std::string &object_path, const int32_t depth = 0)$/

ctags.pattern: /^    bool get_param(T &result, const std::string &obj_path, const std::string &param_name)$/
